streamer.label: Streamer mode
streamer.description: A panel where members deafen themselves (without muting their mic) to stream a game to friends.

feedback.disabled: ❌ Streamer mode is disabled on this server.
feedback.notConfigured: ❌ No Streaming role is configured (an admin must set it on the dashboard).
feedback.roleGone: ❌ The Streaming role no longer exists.
feedback.cannot: ⚠️ I can't: I'm missing « Deafen Members » or « Manage Roles », or the Streaming role is above mine.
feedback.enabledUser: 🎙️ **Streamer mode enabled.** You no longer hear Discord, but your mic keeps broadcasting.
feedback.disabledUser: 🔊 **Streamer mode disabled.** You can hear Discord again.
